## About

Sravan Kumar Sindhe is a branding and digital consulting partner based in Munich. Former Managing Delivery Architect in Capgemini's Adobe CTO Office practice. Delivery owner from first website through full marketing technology stack. TOGAF-informed methodology scaled for SMEs. Author of MACE (open-source MCP for AEM governance) and designer of PACE (predictive content staging for AI-agent environments). Collaborates with Prof. Dr. Markus Degen on senior EMEA client engagements.

## Services (summary)

For growing businesses: digital foundations (web, email, brand), lead capture, CRM and analytics. For established teams: MarTech, customer experience architecture, integrations and applied AI. Export sales development is a separate commercial engagement, not part of standard technology consulting.

## Engagement model

Establish: defined-scope, one-time digital foundation setup. Transition: separately approved, business-goal-driven capability improvements with fixed project budgets. Evolve: optional ongoing support under an agreed annual retainer. This describes commercial engagement and fees, not a technical maturity ladder. Clients may enter at the stage appropriate to their needs; no compulsory sequence or automatic recurring fees. Clients control their accounts and data; third-party software is licensed under vendor terms.

## Capability roadmap

Baseline, Core, Growth and Scale describe illustrative technical capabilities, not compulsory packages or paid stages. Existing assets and systems are assessed and reused where appropriate.
